payload.name: Greatest Labyrinth
payload.description: Pulls all players to the middle of the room. Spawns green arrows in different directions on the arena tiles (except for the middle 4 squares), purple X symbols on three corners, and a blue O symbol on one corner tile. Each player will receive link= Greatest Curse that lasts for 15s. They must cleanse this debuff before it naturally expires or they will instantly die. To cleanse the debuff, players must use the green arrows to transport them to the corner O tile. Touching the X tiles will inflict poison poison, dealing high damage-over-time. The symbols will disappear after the mechanic resolves. The easiest way to solve this is to locate the blue O tile corner work backwards, following the arrows that point to it until they reach the center of the room to find the safe path. Once you have reached the blue O tile, you may safely return to the center of the labyrinth and start attacking the boss once more, without waiting for the maze to disappear.

payload.name: Beastly Roar
payload.description: Spawns a proximity AoE telegraph dealing magical damage at the boss's feet. Players must move to the opposite side of the arena to mitigate. When it resolves, it will additionally spawn a fast-moving set of circle AoEs that will travel clockwise or counterclockwise along the ring, so players must dodge in the opposite direction. Anyone hit by these will be temporarily stunned and knocked up. Using Sprint is recommended. The AoEs will complete slightly less than one full rotation. For uptime, tanks may opt to remain in melee range and use an invulnerability cooldown, although it may not be possible to dodge the rotating AoEs that temporarily stun.

payload.name: Articulated Bits
payload.description: The Armored Chariot moves to the center of the arena and creates an electricity puddle inside its hitbox, which inflicts an electrocution Electrocution damage over time debuff. At the same time, several clockwork Death Claws will appear in the corners, facing the boss. These Death Claws will be marked with pips, either 1 or 2. The Armored Chariot will create violet shields and turn them to face the Death Claws, which in turn fire a large laser. The laser reflects off the shield, creating a cone AoE in that quadrant of the arena. The lasers deal damage over time while standing in them, and will also inflict a strong Sustained Damage damage over time debuff. After the first set of Death Claws fire, the Chariot will rotate its shields to the second set and repeat the process. The second cast of this ability only summons two Death Claws in opposing corners, but also adds several other Death Claws that aim across the arena and not at the Chariot. All of the Death Claws will fire at the same time, leaving narrow safe spots next to the Death Claws not firing directly at the boss. Subsequent casts alternate between the first and second versions.
